description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.6 decomposition step 2. After .6.1 lands the Lint trait carries enough metadata to project each Lint to an OSCAL Control. This bead writes the projection.

## What

New function in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/emit.rs` (or new `pkix-lint/src/oscal/catalog.rs` submodule):

```rust
pub fn catalog_from_lints(
    lints: &[Box<dyn crate::Lint>],
    catalog_id: &str,
    catalog_version: &str,
) -> serde_json::Value
```

Output is OSCAL Catalog v1.1.2 JSON: top-level `{ "catalog": { "uuid": ..., "metadata": ..., "controls": [...] } }`. Each Lint becomes one Control:

- `id` — Lint::id() (must be a valid OSCAL Control id; existing IDs like `cabf.br.tls.validity.max` are dot-separated and lowercase — verify against OSCAL spec).
- `title` — Lint::title().
- `props`: `pkix-lint.citation`, `pkix-lint.severity`, `pkix-lint.scope` (cert/path), `pkix-lint.applies-to` (leaf/intermediate/anchor-issued/any).
- `parts`: `statement` (if Lint::description() returns Some), `assessment-objective` (if defined).
- `links`: `rel=reference` with href=rfc_url() when present.
- Deterministic UUIDs via the existing uuid_v8 helper (RFC 9562 §5.8) seeded with the catalog_id + lint id.

## Acceptance

- [ ] catalog_from_lints emits a valid OSCAL Catalog JSON Value.
- [ ] Test asserts top-level shape matches OSCAL Catalog v1.1.2 (required fields uuid, metadata, controls present).
- [ ] Test verifies a sample Lint maps to a Control with matching id, title, citation prop, rfc-url link.
- [ ] Output is byte-deterministic across runs with the same input.
- [ ] Full pkix-lint suite passes; `oscal` feature gated.

## Out of scope

- Catalog deserialization / round-trip — that's .6.3.
- Parameter declarations on Controls — that's .6.4.

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.6.1 (trait metadata).
title: OSCAL Catalog JSON serializer for registered Lints
